summary: German company standard comparison report for two measurements of one patient: a cover page with identity and per-measurement lines, a table of contents, method prose, questionnaire comparisons, both task behaviour tables, spectra, theta/beta ratio, arousal index, coherence, ICA component and channel ERP comparisons, and a company signature block. Almost every result section is laid out for exactly two measurements, and several clinic texts interpret results with mental-function or condition labels.

theme.page: A4 portrait; margins 20 mm left and right, 25 mm top, 37.5 mm bottom (header 12.5 mm, footer 19.8 mm); about 33 pages
theme.cover: title page: a Word cover-page content control with a decorative curve band (about 108 x 18 mm) at the top behind a large white title in a text box, a large centred company logo (about 120 x 36 mm), a company address text box, the identity and measurement lines and a small company logo at the foot in place of the footer
theme.fonts: Trebuchet MS and Calibri (theme fonts), Tahoma in places; body mostly 9 to 12 pt; localisation labels 9 pt; cover title 28 and 36 pt; no Japanese glyphs needed
theme.colours: dark navy for header, footer and accents; lime green accents on the cover and in the footer; grey table shading; legend text coloured blue, green, dark blue and red to match the device curve colours; white cover title and hidden language line
theme.header: from page 2: report title, patient last name and first name, birth-date label and slot, page number
theme.footer: from page 2: company logo (about 40 x 12 mm) and a company contact text box (company line)

images.detail: logos: large cover logo, small cover logo, footer logo (the small one reused); banner: cover curve band; other: 11 static localisation pictures in the ICA component tables (10 distinct files) and 1 scanned signature

theme_gaps: different first page: cover without running header and footer, with a small logo standing in for the footer
cover page built from a content control with layered images and text boxes (white title over a band image)
section numbering: roman numerals typed into chapter headings, automatic numbering for second-level headings
running header with patient slots (last name, first name, birth date) and a page number from page 2
start on new page: 26 manual page breaks, several inside figure paragraphs (mockup assumption: a block option)
legend text coloured to match the fixed device curve colours, which couples clinic text colour to device colours

elements.what: Word table of contents field with page numbers; its cached entries carry the questionnaire block markers so that removed blocks also remove their entries

elements.what: Stale entries in the contents list for a therapy recommendation chapter (an age-conditional everyday-life entry, medication, further advice) that the body does not contain
elements.legacy: cached TOC text with |age16+| and |age16-| conditions
elements.note: Rule 7: the only age condition in T08 sits in recommendation entries; no neutral age-dependent text. Cached field text, not a further table row

elements.what: Chapter and section headings of the report body (typed roman chapter numbers, automatically numbered sections)
elements.note: Clinic heading text; numbering is a theme need

elements.what: Disclaimer limiting what the method can replace or diagnose and pointing to a neurological examination by a specialist
elements.note: Neutral limitation statement

elements.what: Method description of about 290 words: cap and montage, reference, impedance limit, amplifier make and recording system, filter band, recording protocol and durations, artefact handling, spectral analysis and norm comparison
elements.note: Rule 13: recording parameters and norm description typed as clinic text; no regulatory claim

elements.what: Paragraph promising advice on how to improve cortical function, followed by a caution that results describe one point in time
elements.note: The core gives no recommendations (intended-use section 4). The caution sentence is neutral and a clinic may keep it in its own words

elements.what: Caveat on the accuracy of the localisation figures
elements.note: Neutral; it concerns the localisation pictures of the ICA component tables (open), so it goes if that analysis is not kept

elements.what: Everyday-load questionnaire comparison: an explanation that maps answers to brain structures, a figure and lists of improved, worsened and unchanged items
elements.legacy: grafik_<author>, list_<author>_better/_worse/_same, blockstart_<author> (marker names contain the questionnaire author)
elements.note: Q4. V3 computes it but always deletes the block in comparison reports (audit 14d DX11), so it never prints. The whole questionnaire chapter goes when either measurement lacks questionnaires

elements.what: ADHD questionnaire comparison: points before, after and difference per ADHD presentation type with static diagnostic-criteria text in the rows, and lists of changed behaviours
elements.note: Q4. Rows name conditions and diagnostic thresholds

elements.what: Symptom checklist comparison: short description of the instrument, figure, list of scales above the cut-off
elements.note: Q4

elements.what: Parent behaviour checklist comparison: explanation with severity words for the colour zones, two figures, comparison lists
elements.note: Q4. The severity words read as clinical abnormality (text-layer brief section 3)

elements.what: Comorbidity questionnaire comparison: lists of items present only in one measurement or in both
elements.note: Q4

elements.what: Intelligence test comparison tables in three versions (first, last, difference), one kept per test type
elements.note: Q4 (cognitive tests). Audit 14d: the IQ comparison never runs, and one test overwrites the other when both exist (DX10)

elements.what: Task introduction naming the mental functions the task is said to inform on
elements.note: Rule 4: introduction with mental-function labels; could be held but must not be

elements.what: Behaviour tables for measurement 1 and measurement 2 (one per measurement, its recording date and time in the heading): percent correct, omissions, commissions, mean reaction time and its variability with p values, for Go and NoGo
elements.note: Rule 11: one table per measurement, fixed to two. Two cells per table are typed as a fixed zero for errors that cannot occur in that condition; a V4 device table would show them as not applicable. Header labels are e27

elements.what: Column labels of the behaviour tables naming attention, impulsivity and work constancy instead of the measures
elements.note: Legacy construct labels replaced by the measure names of the V4 device table (text-layer brief section 8; intended-use section 4)

elements.what: Reaction time course figures, measurement 1 left and measurement 2 right
elements.note: Rule 11: paired markers fixed to two measurements. Row aligned with the other templates

elements.what: Reaction time histograms, measurement 1 and 2
elements.note: Rule 11

elements.what: Errors per interval figures, measurement 1 and 2
elements.note: Rule 11. V3 counts errors per 2 minutes (audit 14d), table 3.3 per block of 40 trials

elements.what: Caption of the reaction time course figures: explains the marks for values outside the norm and names omission and commission errors with mental-function labels; English terms in parentheses
elements.legacy: static text with a figure numbering field
elements.note: Rule 4. Also names left and right positions for two measurements

elements.what: Caption of the reaction time histograms: interprets right-hand outliers with a mental-function label (inconsistency)
elements.legacy: static text with a figure numbering field
elements.note: Rule 4

elements.what: Caption of the errors per interval figures: swaps the omission and commission labels and reads late errors as fatigue
elements.legacy: static text with a figure numbering field
elements.note: Rule 17: defect (swapped labels); the interpretation would also be claim wording

elements.what: Text block marker after the task figures
elements.note: Marker not described in the audit (unclear). If it inserts a generated behaviour sentence it is legacy text to leave out

elements.what: Short introduction stating recording duration, conditions, spectral analysis, comparison with an age-matched norm and the montage
elements.note: Rule 13: recording parameters and norm description typed as clinic text

elements.what: Raw EEG excerpts for the three conditions (EO, EC, task), each for measurement 1 and 2 (6)
elements.note: Rule 11

elements.what: Absolute and relative spectra comparison figures per condition (6), each drawn by the device with both measurements and their difference
elements.analysis_row: Absolute and relative spectra against norms
elements.note: One device-made comparison figure per marker, so the template layout is not fixed to two; also table 3.3 row Repeated measurements side by side

elements.what: Inline headings and colour legends of the spectra figures (one colour per measurement and one for the difference), typed into the figure paragraphs between manual page breaks
elements.note: Rule 4: neutral legend typed by the clinic; it is correct only for two measurements, so in V4 the device comparison block should carry its own legend. The manual page breaks are a theme need

elements.what: Frequency component figures per condition, one marker per measurement
elements.analysis_row: Frequency markers (the clinician marks frequency components on the spectra) and automatic peak suggestions
elements.note: Rule 11: comp1 and comp2 are measurement 1 and 2 (audit 14d D3.5); V3 deletes them when no frequency plot exists (14d D3.6 step 4)

elements.what: Introduction calling the ratio an inattention index, linking it to ADHD subtypes and citing a published study (author not reproduced)
elements.note: Rule 4: explanation next to a device figure that names a condition and a mental function

elements.what: Theta/beta ratio comparison maps for eyes open and the task: subject 1, subject 2 and the norm
elements.note: Device-made comparison figure; the norm head is the norm of measurement 2 only (audit 14a A7)

elements.what: Captions naming the position of measurement 1, measurement 2 and the norm in each map row
elements.note: Rule 4: neutral; correct only for two measurements

elements.what: Arousal index section: description tying the index to autonomic arousal and naming the recording sites, comparison tables per condition (Stanine and percentile per measurement, difference) and a version line
elements.note: Static text inside a later-module section takes its class. Construct name (arousal); condition labels of the tables are in English in a German template

elements.what: Coherence introduction that explains the line colours and reads high positive and negative coherence as too much or too little communication between sites
elements.note: Rule 4: interpretation with a mental-function label

elements.what: Caption stating which measurement is shown above and which below
elements.note: Rule 4: neutral; correct only for two measurements

elements.what: Coherence maps per condition for measurement 1 and 2 (6), each under a label with that measurement's recording date and time
elements.analysis_row: Coherence per electrode pair and band
elements.note: Rule 11. V3 copies the rendered single-report figure of each measurement (audit 14a A5, comparison variant)

elements.what: Global magnitude-squared coherence printed under each band head of the coherence figures
elements.note: Rule 15; four lines under each head (audit 14a A5 step 3.4)

elements.what: Instantaneous, lagged and total coherence printed under each band head of the coherence figures
elements.note: Rule 15 (audit 14a A5 step 3.4)

elements.what: Eleven ICA component comparison figure sets (difference, after, before) in layout tables, with a static introduction tying the potentials to information processing, colour legends, anatomical localisation labels, function labels per component and 11 static localisation pictures
elements.note: Static text and pictures inside an open section take its class. Function labels are mental-function names; the legend mentions a significance of the difference, while a change test is not planned in V4. V3 takes the component pictures from measurement 1 only (audit 14d D3.5)

elements.what: Go minus NoGo difference waves for both measurements, without norm
elements.note: Device-made comparison figure

elements.what: Novelty, Go and NoGo waves with both measurements, the norm and the difference (3 figures)
elements.note: Device-made comparison figures with significance strips of each measurement against its own norm (audit 14d D3.5)

elements.what: Static explanation lines (conditions, stimulus shown, no norm for the difference) and colour legends of the channel ERP figures
elements.note: Rule 4: neutral; the legends are correct only for two measurements

elements.what: Closing block: company name, a department line and a named signatory
elements.note: Rule 14: fixed named signatory typed into the template; every report would look signed by that person whoever issues it (spec 3.5)

elements.what: Scanned handwritten signature image (about 53 x 30 mm, behind text)
elements.note: Rule 14. v1 called it a logo

elements.what: Header from page 2: report title, patient last name and first name, birth-date label and slot, page number
elements.note: Sits in a content control. Same biomarker title wording as e02

elements.what: Footer from page 2: company logo (about 40 x 12 mm) and a company contact text box
elements.legacy: image, static text in a text box
elements.note: One image and one text box, not two images

not_expressible.what: Word table of contents with page numbers
not_expressible.why: The schema has no generated table of contents or page references
not_expressible.suggestion: A company-owned table-of-contents block generated at render time from the block titles; no clinic-typed page references

not_expressible.what: Per-measurement placeholders and paired markers that fix the layout to exactly two measurements (cover lines, task tables, task figures, raw EEG, frequency components, coherence maps)
not_expressible.why: V4 shows any number of measurements side by side (spec 3.4, working decision); I6 names no per-measurement placeholders or multi-measurement device blocks
not_expressible.suggestion: Device comparison blocks and per-measurement placeholders (date and time per condition) parameterised by the number of measurements the clinician selects; descriptive only, no change statistic

not_expressible.what: Recording parameters, amplifier make, montage, protocol and norm description typed as clinic prose
not_expressible.why: These facts belong to device metadata and can contradict the recording
not_expressible.suggestion: A device method block or device metadata placeholders filled from the recording and the specification; template validation rejects clinic text that states device parameters

not_expressible.what: Fixed named signatory in the closing block
not_expressible.why: A report is final when the issuing clinician issues it (spec 3.5); a typed signatory signs every report
not_expressible.suggestion: An issue-time signature block filled from the issuing user (name, qualification, date and time of issue, report version); no named signatories or signature images in clinic blocks

review_response.finding: F7 (pseudonymisation): exact report counts and shares equal the export manifest and allow re-identification
review_response.reason: reports_per_year and share_pct are taken from usage_rounded.json (rounded).

review_response.finding: F31 (classify-2): the extractor skipped content controls; re-extract and re-check every model
review_response.reason: Model rebuilt from tpl_extract_v2 (content controls, text boxes, headers and footers) and checked against the raw XML of the docx.

review_response.finding: F98 (completeness): one class rule per feature, a separate leave-out class, and every element needing a listed schema change classed not_expressible
review_response.reason: Brief v2 rules applied: leave_out with leave_reason replaces dropped or not_expressible for control lines and similar content; every element behind a not_expressible list entry has that class and its gap code.

review_response.finding: F79 (numbers): the same legacy feature gets different classes depending on the modelling group
review_response.reason: Same rule set as all groups: table of contents G5, hidden control and language lines leave_out control_marker, no manual checklist tables in this template set.

review_response.finding: F2 and F3 (pseudonymisation): close paraphrases of fixed sentences and an overstated no-quote claim
review_response.reason: Descriptions state the function of a text, not its wording. Checked: no run of 4 words (hyphens split) of the raw docx text, including content controls, text boxes, headers and footers, occurs in this file apart from marker names; no Japanese characters occur in it.

review_response.finding: F105 (completeness): suggestions that cross hard rule 5 (draft starters, condition or treatment rows)
review_response.reason: No suggestion in this model proposes a feature whose use is treatment advice, diagnosis or a prefilled verdict.

review_response.finding: F108 and F81 (completeness, numbers): claim wording was counted only on clinic-class elements and the per-model field disagreed with the report
review_response.reason: claim_wording and claim_kind are set on every element whatever its class; the old field claim_wording_clinic_blocks is dropped.

review_response.finding: F42 (classify-2, rule for all): footnotes are not modelled and are not a block kind
review_response.reason: Checked in the raw XML: this template has no footnote references, so no footnote element is needed.

review_response.finding: F28 (classify-2): the cover page in a content control is missing and the e21 note is false
review_response.reason: Cover modelled as e01 to e11 (band image, title, logos, address, language line, identity, measurement lines, referrer, reason line, notes slots); the false note is gone.

review_response.finding: F97 (completeness): cover and running header in content controls missed; Empty header is false
review_response.reason: Running header e55 and cover elements added; theme.header corrected.

review_response.finding: F36 (classify-2): the signature-block image is a scanned signature; theme misses cover images and over-counts the footer
review_response.reason: e53 (G11) and e54 (leave_out scanned_signature); theme.images counts the cover band, three logo placements, 11 localisation pictures and the signature; footer has one image and one text box (e56).

review_response.finding: F38 (classify-2): TextBlock_Performance classed to_confirm under a Core row although its meaning is unclear; align the RT course row
review_response.reason: e34 is open with analysis_row null and the note unclear; e28 uses Reaction time variability as in the other templates.

review_response.finding: F33 and F77 (classify-2, numbers): coverage counted only not_expressible elements, so T08 showed 100% while listing G3, G5 and G8
review_response.reason: Every element needing a listed gap now has class not_expressible: e12 (G5), e07, e26, e28, e29, e30, e36, e39, e46 (G8), e16, e35 (G10), e53 (G11). G3 does not apply (see F84).

review_response.finding: F79 (numbers): the table of contents was device in T04, T08 and T12 but a gap elsewhere
review_response.reason: e12 is not_expressible G5 (rule 1).

review_response.finding: F111 (completeness): the assumption that a table of contents is a device layout feature is not surfaced
review_response.reason: Assumption withdrawn (e12 note). The referrer slot assumption is in the e08 note; adding assumptions to README.md is for the report writer.

review_response.finding: F84 and F99 (numbers, completeness): T08 has no age condition outside a stale entry of its contents list; G3 should not list it
review_response.reason: e13 is leave_out treatment_advice; no G3 entry and no neutral age-dependent text found in T08.

review_response.finding: F85 and F106 (numbers, completeness): recording and norm facts typed as clinic text in T08 are not under G10

review_response.finding: F103 (completeness): signature blocks counted as covered clinic content

review_response.finding: F110 (completeness): no gap row for per-measurement placeholders and multi-measurement forms

review_response.finding: F90 (numbers): manual page-break layout and the always-deleted questionnaire block are in no list

review_response.finding: F40 (classify-2): English text in T08 (arousal table labels, caption phrase) missing from the mixed-language list

review_response.finding: F63 (classify-4, rule for all): lagged, instantaneous and total coherence printed under the coherence heads need their own open element

review_response.finding: F45 and F62 (rule for all): fixed verdict sentences classed clinician

review_response.finding: F49 and F73 (rule for all): static text inside open or later-module sections handled inconsistently
review_response.reason: Static text inside an open or later-module section takes that section class with claim flags (e19, e20, e22, e43, e49); text in the introduction or next to core figures is its own element.
